basics.name: Ediyono
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience in end-to-end solution design, development and complex system integration. Proven track record leading multi-national teams across Southeast Asia, building and scaling regional payment systems. Recently applying agentic AI systems to accelerate software delivery and automate development workflows.

work.name: Xendit Pte. Ltd.
highlights: Led design and delivery of regional payment products across SEA markets, end to end with product and engineering teams.

work.name: Xendit Pte. Ltd.
highlights: Managed 4 sub-teams (3–5 engineers each, ~16 engineers across ID, MY, SG and PH) building and scaling regional payout products; owned strategy, roadmap and prioritisation with product managers.
Led payout integrations with regional bank partners, opening new payment channels across Southeast Asia.
Designed scalable payment architecture for customers' high-volume payout transactions (AWS, Kubernetes, microservices, DDD).

work.name: Deloitte Digital SEA
highlights: Designed and delivered complex system-integration solutions end to end (Azure, MuleSoft, API Gateway, .NET).
Coordinated off-shore and on-site teams to complete project deliverables.

work.name: Traveloka
highlights: Built and automated integration pipelines between product systems and Finance & Accounting (AWS, Java, Node.js).

work.name: Accenture
highlights: Developed end-to-end systems and customised third-party applications to client requirements (IBM Cognos TM1, AWS, Heroku, ASP.NET, Node.js SPA / hybrid mobile apps).

projects.name: OpenClaw Multi-Agent AI System
projects.description: Self-hosted system of 5 specialised Claude agents (architect, programmer, analyst, scout, assistant) that plan, code, review and merge PRs across 6 repos, plus daily automated research digests and financial-report parsing.

projects.name: IDX Financial Dashboard
projects.description: Interactive dashboard for analysing IDX-listed companies. React, TypeScript, Material-UI, Recharts.

projects.name: IDX Report Ingestion Pipeline
projects.description: Job-queued agent pipeline: a Claude analyst agent parses IDX financial-report PDFs into per-period JSON, writes rated analyses (bear/base/bull targets) and daily watchlist news, all feeding the IDX Financial Dashboard via auto-merged PRs.

projects.name: Store Inventory Manager
projects.description: Multi-location inventory app in production for a retail business. Next.js, TypeScript, Google Sheets, Vercel.

projects.name: Payout Routing Service Re-architecture & Migration
projects.description: Xendit, architect + backend lead. Redesigned multi-currency routing; new region/currency rollout cut from 2 months to 2 weeks.

projects.name: Payout Partner Integration Re-architecture
projects.description: Xendit, architect + backend lead. Hybrid-monolith partner integrations; new partner onboarding down from 6–8 to 3–4 weeks.

projects.name: AWS EKS Migration
projects.description: Xendit, backend lead. Migrated disbursement microservices EBS/EC2 → EKS: deployment time −80%, infra cost −40%.

_archived_projects.description: Xendit, Jan–Jun 2020, architect + backend lead. Scaled batch payouts to 10x traffic; introduced an internal batch API for multi-payment processing.
